import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[1:N+1]]
    
    pos = [0] * (N + 2)
    for i in range(N):
        pos[P[i]] = i + 1  # 1-indexed
    
    # Fenwick tree (BIT)
    bit = [0] * (N + 2)
    
    def update(i):
        while i <= N:
            bit[i] += 1
            i += i & -i
    
    def query(i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s
    
    total = 0
    for v in range(1, N + 1):
        p = pos[v]
        update(p)
        q = query(p)
        if q < v:
            # cost = sum from q to v-1
            total += (v - 1 + q) * (v - q) // 2
    
    print(total)
